run_dmpo_experiment: run the distributional MPO agent on a continuous control environment like HalfCheetah-v2
build_experiment_config: build an MPO experiment config with network factory and agent builder for continuous control
configure_mpo_agent: configure an MPO agent with categorical critic and Gaussian policy loss for reinforcement learning

create_network_factory: create an MPO network factory with configurable policy and critic layer sizes for control tasks
